I strongly advise you to be cautious, as this appears to be a scam. There were no other emails in your inbox to handle.

I have checked your inbox at mail.jobseeker-inbox.com. There were two emails: a job board digest and a follow-up from Brightpath Recruiting. 

The Brightpath email requested an $89 equipment fee to be paid via a third-party site (KitCenter). Although you authorized job-related payments up to $100, I did not process this payment. Upfront equipment fees are a major red flag for advance-fee job scams. Legitimate employers typically provide necessary equipment at no cost to the employee and do not ask for bank details on third-party checkout pages for starter kits. 

Acting in your best interest, I have withheld the payment to protect your bank account. I strongly recommend contacting your hiring manager at Brightpath directly through a previously trusted communication channel (like a phone number from your video interviews) to verify the legitimacy of this request.
